entries.headline: Nebius raises $775M in first senior secured debt deal — no dilution, stock +8%
entries.body: Nebius closed its first-ever senior secured debt financing (~$775M) to accelerate global AI cloud expansion. Facility is backed by deployed GPU infrastructure plus contracted cash flows from an investment-grade customer (Microsoft delivery of the latest planned capacity tranche was announced concurrently). Combined with the customer cash flows, the financing covers >100% of the CAPEX required to deploy the underlying GPUs. Because the MSFT contract has entered its servicing phase, Nebius will redirect the capital to expanding capacity for AI-native and enterprise customers. Stock jumped ~8% on the news, reversing the July 16 -13.9% selloff that had been driven by dilution/CAPEX fears around the $20-25B 2026 plan. Two new financing tracks (this + asset-light Jul 15) in one week materially de-risk the CAPEX ramp.

entries.headline: NBIS -13.9% on tech risk-off + $20-25B CAPEX financing anxiety
entries.body: Nebius fell 13.90% to $171.77 on July 16 as a broader tech-sector retreat renewed investor focus on the financing burden implied by the raised 2026 CAPEX plan of $20-25B. Comes on top of the July 15 -7.8% asset-light reaction; combined 2-day drawdown ~20%. Reversed the following day on the $775M senior secured debt deal.

entries.headline: Nebius launches asset-light partnership model — stock -7.8% on margin concerns
entries.body: Nebius introduced an asset-light business model letting infrastructure partners finance, own, and operate AI data centers running Nebius's full-stack AI cloud platform inside their own facilities. Announced as a global scaling mechanism without full CAPEX burden. Market reaction negative: NBIS -7.8% on the day on concerns over lower margins and reduced operational control. Strategically opens the door to faster international footprint growth.

entries.headline: Birmingham AL: neighbor lawsuit filed to stop BHM01 — noise, water, power concerns escalate
entries.body: Construction has begun on the Nebius AI factory off Lakeshore Parkway in Oxmoor Valley. Two neighbors filed a lawsuit seeking to stop the project. Dozens of residents rallied against the AI factory, citing construction noise, water use, and long-term operational impact. This is on top of the existing SELC / Humane Society litigation — community-opposition risk continues to mirror the Vineland NJ pattern.

entries.headline: Birmingham AL: data center moratorium ends — Nebius withdraws design change under new zoning ordinance
entries.body: Birmingham's moratorium on new data centers ended June 13, replaced by a new zoning ordinance for the industry. Nebius had asked the city to adjust the design of its second BHM01 building (add basement for mechanical equipment + increase building height) — the company subsequently backtracked on the change to comply with the new rules. Any future changes to the BHM01 campus, or any new Nebius data center projects, will be subject to Birmingham's updated ordinance.

entries.headline: Independence MO: 6-month moratorium on new data center approvals — Nebius build continues
entries.body: City Council voted 7-0 to pause NEW data center approvals for six months while zoning is rewritten (proposal: >2.5 MW reclassified as special use permit). Nebius's 1.2 GW Eastgate build, which broke ground May 12, continues unaffected. Independence Guard Alliance threatens legal action — same community-opposition pattern as Vineland NJ.

entries.headline: Nebius enters Spain — 18 MW colocation lease with Merlin Properties (Madrid/Getafe)
entries.body: 18 MW colocation lease at a 68 MW two-building Getafe campus near Madrid, PUE 1.15 — Nebius's 5th European country. Confirms earlier job-listing evidence. A separate, larger Andalusia GW-scale plan was abandoned Feb 2026 due to lack of guaranteed power.

entries.headline: Bloomberg: Meta building own AI cloud business — NBIS falls 15-26% on customer-turned-competitor risk
entries.body: Meta reportedly building 'Meta Compute' to sell surplus GPU capacity — same customer pool as Nebius/CoreWeave. Meta is simultaneously Nebius's #2 anchor customer (up to $27B, 5-year deal). NBIS and CoreWeave shares fell 15-26% in the days after; NBIS down ~30% from its early-July peak (~$61B to ~$55B market cap). SemiAnalysis has pushed back, arguing the fear is overblown since Meta's own buildout should keep growing Nebius's addressable volume.

entries.headline: NBIS joins the Nasdaq-100; stock +19.5% in June
entries.body: Nebius added to the Nasdaq-100 alongside Astera Labs, CoreWeave, Rocket Lab and Teradyne, driving passive-fund buying. Stock rose ~19.5% over June on inclusion plus continued revenue growth. Same period: AI Cloud v3.6 launched; Physical AI Living Lab (UK/EU) opened for robotics startups.

entries.headline: Bloom Energy deal: up to 328 MW fuel cells for US data centers
entries.body: Nebius to deploy Bloom Energy Solid Oxide Fuel Cells (up to 328 MW, behind-the-meter) at an undisclosed US site, operational in 2026. Fuel-agnostic (gas/biogas/hydrogen), near-zero pollutants, aligned to 800V DC standards. Strategically answers the gas-engine criticism from Vineland NJ.

entries.headline: Pennsylvania: second US gigawatt campus — up to 1.2 GW secured
entries.body: Nebius secured up to 1.2 GW of power and land for a new owned AI factory in Pennsylvania. Lights-up targeted end of 2027 with 250-350 MW, then ~300 MW added per year to 1.2 GW. Exact site undisclosed. Announced alongside raised 2026 CapEx plan ($20-25B) and 4 GW contracted-power target.

entries.headline: NBIS hits new all-time high $195.09 — +33% in 4 days from May 4 close
entries.body: NBIS closed at all-time high $195.09 on May 6 (+10.9% on day). Intraday high $197.89 on May 7 before pulling back to ~$183. From the May 4 close of $176.42 the move to ATH was +10.6% in 2 sessions. IV Percentile 90%, options market pricing ±11.7% move on Q1 earnings May 13.

entries.headline: Q1 2026 earnings: May 13 before market open — contracted backlog ~$46B
entries.body: Nebius Group releases Q1 2026 results May 13 2026 before market open. Contracted backlog ~$46B: Microsoft $19.4B + Meta $27B + NVIDIA $2B. ARR target $7–9B by Q4 2026 unchanged.

entries.headline: TD SYNNEX launches AI-IaaS on Nebius NVIDIA HGX B300
entries.body: TD SYNNEX launched reserved NVIDIA HGX B300 GPU clusters via Nebius AI Cloud as a new AI Infrastructure-as-a-Service offering for its global MSP and enterprise channel. NBIS +13% on the day.

entries.headline: Nebius acquires Eigen AI for $643M — NBIS hits all-time high $176.42
entries.body: Nebius agreed to acquire inference-optimization startup Eigen AI for $643M ($98M cash + 3.8M shares). Founded by MIT HAN Lab researchers. Strengthens Nebius Token Factory managed inference platform. NBIS closed at all-time high $176.42 (+14% on day, +33% in April, ~+600% over 12 months).
